name: Turkey
identity: Golden tan spotted turkey with a long cream neck, attached gold wattle, rounded tan body, two folded feather wings, two clawed feet, and a broad cream-and-ochre fan tail.

source_observations.silhouette: The original has a rounded golden-tan spotted body, long cream neck and gold wattle, folded wings, two clawed legs, and a broad cream-and-ochre fan tail.
source_observations.head: HeadNormal, HeadAngry and HeadDead are separate source expressions. Up uses one consistent featureless rear head/neck silhouette; Down uses the corresponding source expressions.
source_observations.body: Keep the spotted torso and rump as one central cutout. Do not paint the separately-authored tail fan or wings onto the body.
source_observations.limbs: The source prefab has separate Wing, LegL and LegR renderers. Each sheet cell is one complete source-side limb cutout; the installed rig must preserve the original paired limb count.
source_observations.tail: Tail is its own broad fan-feather renderer, not a narrow tuft. Preserve its centerline attachment and validate pivot/overlap against the source prefab before installation.
source_observations.prefab_contract: Preserve the original root scale, SortingGroup, Animator, Collider, BaseEnemy, HpBar, Shadow and animation-event receiver. No shared C# changes are planned.
source_observations.animation_contract: Retain the Turkey controller parameters and Idle/Ready/Walk/Run/Attack/Death behavior, including Attack SetHead expression events and Death HeadDead event.

orientation_contract.Up: Axial rear view travelling screen-up. No eyes, beak or front facial features; head includes the full neck and keeps the wattle in its source location, naturally hidden from directly behind.
orientation_contract.Down: Axial front view travelling screen-down. Beak below the eyes; cream neck and gold wattle remain attached to the head/neck cutout.
orientation_contract.pairing: The sheet uses one folded wing cell and one leg cell; final assembly must retain two wings and two legs.
orientation_contract.tail: Use a broad symmetrical cream-and-ochre fan attached at the rump centerline; never replace it with a narrow rooster tail or duplicate it on the body.
